units: ticks int; anchorX16 = tick * 65536 (Q48.16); fees 0.16 fixed point; times uint32 seconds; all integers are decimal strings

rules.gate: lObs + mGate >= eRef, lObs = snapBits if lastPosTime == now else bitlen(activeLiquidity)
rules.decay: off = anchor - tick*65536; |off'| = ((|off| >> (dt / tau)) << 64) / exp2(((dt % tau) << 64) / tau) (src/math/exp2.sol, 5.64 in, 64.64 out); move = clamp(off' - off, +-(clamp << 16) * min(dt, tau) / tau)
rules.raise: e + 1 if L > e and now - lRefRaiseTime >= tau (then lRefRaiseTime = now), else e
rules.segmentFee: min(maxFee, poolFee + ceil(slopeK * poolFee * (lo + hi - 2 * anchor) / (4 * spacing * 65536)))
rules.boundaries: first jLin on the W grid strictly beyond the anchor, then widths 2W, 4W, ...; segments are visited starting with the first boundary strictly beyond the current sqrt ratio
rules.toward: one call with the caller's minFee to tickToSqrtRatio(floor(anchor)) (increasing) or ceil (decreasing)
rules.budget: at most jLin + 24 away calls; merge to the user limit once the fee is maxFee or at the last call

source: EkuboProtocol/evm-contracts da368348, test/data/mevcapture-v21 (anchor updates of the variant whose allowance floors)
